newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy lower house votes for Albania force.
newsitem.headline: Italy lower house votes for Albania force.

text.p: Italy's lower house of parliament voted overwhelmingly on Wednesday in favour of deploying an Italian-led security force to Albania, the speaker of parliament announced.
The vote was 503 to 85 with seven absentions.

The centre-left coalition government parties and the main centre-right opposition voted in favour but the Communist Refoundation party, which normally secures the government's majority, and the separatist Northern League voted against.
Refoundation's stance marked the first time it had broken ranks with Prime Minister Romano Prodi on a major policy issue.

Prodi said earlier that he would go immediately after the vote to inform President Oscar Luigi Scalfaro of the situation. Scalfaro is expected to send Prodi back to parliament for a confidence vote to decide whether his government can survive.
